title: Posted test cases (…-test-keys.json)
description: Written by scripts/tracker/post-tests.js after every case. The record of what exists in the tracker for a ticket; safe to re-run against.

status.description: created: new this run · deduplicated: already existed · failed: see error · skipped: the run stopped before reaching it

id.description: the tracker's id for the test case (present once it exists, even if linking failed)

repaired.description: a half-built item from an earlier attempt was completed

partial.description: a multi-call create failed part-way; this is the item it left behind
